Heroes at an Incident.text: At a live villain incident the hero on scene leads. A pro acts at once to stop the villain, protect people and call for backup, without waiting for police permission, and a student with a provisional license may act in an emergency. Officers support them: cordons, evacuation, traffic, first aid, transport and custody. The police never order a pro to stand down while a villain is loose. Detectives such as Naomasa Tsukauchi take over afterward, or when a case needs investigation rather than a fight; even then heroes are partners who are briefed and sent in, not subordinates. An investigation moves every scene: a lead, a witness, a location, a raid, never days of waiting. A villain does not wait for the heroes to finish talking; they keep acting on their own plan, so every delay costs something.
